title: Appending a unary state symbol
statement: For every natural number $n$, updating the unary state tape encoding $n$ by writing $1$ in cell $n+1$ gives the unary state tape encoding $n+1$.
replaced:
Writing the bit $1$ into cell $n + 1$ of the intact unary state tape encoding
the index $n$ yields the intact unary state tape encoding the index $n + 1$.
